scripts.pages:build: NEXT_TURBO=0 npx @opennextjs/cloudflare build --non-interactive && (rm -rf out-pages || true) && mkdir out-pages && cp -rv .open-next/. out-pages/ && cp -rv .open-next/assets/. out-pages/ && ( [ -f out-pages/worker.js ] && mv out-pages/worker.js out-pages/_worker.js || true ) && echo '{"version":1,"include":["/*"],"exclude":["/_next/static/*","/favicon.ico","/logo/*","/carrusel/*","/icons/*","/profes/*","/options/*","/fonts/*","/*.png","/*.jpg","/*.jpeg","/*.svg","/*.webp","/*.mjs","/pdf.worker.min.mjs","/pago-exitoso.html"]}' > out-pages/_routes.json && echo --- ESTRUCTURA FINAL --- && ls -R out-pages
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy
